Guidance & outlook: The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on August 11, 2026, has recommended dividend of Rs.1.20/- per equity share of the face value of Rs.10/- for FY 2025-26 for the approval of members at the ensuing thirty-second AGM.

Pursuant to the provisions of regulation 42 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the ‘SEBI Listing Regulations') the Company has fixed Tuesday, September 22, 2026 as the ‘Record Date' for the purpose of determining the members eligible to receive dividend for FY2025-26.

Regulation 34 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, Delay in submission of the Annual Report for the FY 2024-25 BSE & NSE Penalty / Fine imposed One day delay in submission of the Annual Report for the FY 2024-25 Rs.2,360/- by each stock exchange Management requested for waiver, however stock exchanges not considered.
Growth & demand: This growth reflects the strong operational performance and effective execution of strategic initiatives and reflecting the growth of 121%.
942.08 Lakhs in the previous year, indicating enhanced operational efficiency and profitability and reflecting notable growth of 163%.

Return on Equity (+121%) Retur n on Equity improved significantly owing to substantial growth in profit after tax during the year, supported by higher revenue from operations and improved operating margins.
Margins & costs: Income from Operations increased by approximately 121%, while EBITDA increased by approximately 149% on the Standalone basis.

(C) COST AUDITORS The provisions of Section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014, relating to the maintenance of cost records and appointment of Cost Auditors, are not applicable to the Company.

Debt-Equity Ratio (+66%) The Debt-Equity Ratio increased from 0.16 to 0.27 mainly due to higher utilization of borrowings to support working capital requirements and execution of large-value projects awarded during the year.
Capex & expansion: Modern Record Rooms Project, Jharkhand (`77.97 Crore) Implementation of Modern Record Rooms through digitization of land and revenue records using Document Management Software, including supply, installation and commissioning of hardware infrastructure across 38 locations.

Subsequent to the close of the financial year, the Company acquired the remaining 26% equity shares of TS Innovations Private Limited with effect from 13 June 2026, pursuant to which it became a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
The remaining 26% equity shares were acquired by the Company with effect from 13 June 2026, pursuant to which TS Innovations Private Limited became a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company.
Balance sheet & cash: DIVIDEND The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on August 11, 2026, has recommended a Final Dividend of 12% i.e. `1.20/- (Rupee One and Twenty Paise Only) per equity share of face value `10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, for the financial year ended on March 31, 2026, out of profits.

Debt Service Coverage Ratio (+27%) The Debt Service Coverage Ratio increased from 4.31 to 5.46 mainly due to the Company received additional loans from the Directors, resulting in an increase in debt.

Trade Receivable Turnover Ratio (+90%) The T rade Receivable Turnover Ratio improved considerably due to higher revenue generation and more efficient collection of trade receivables during the year, reflecting improved receivables management.
Risks & challenges: The Company has established a process for periodically placing before the Audit Committee the risk assessment reports, risk minimization initiatives and the measures taken to mitigate identified risks.
RISK MANAGEMENT The Company has an integrated risk management framework covering business, operational, compliance, and financial risks.
